articles.title: Bank of America Declares First Quarter 2026 Stock Dividends
articles.mainIdea: Bank of America Declares First Quarter 2026 Stock Dividends
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Bank of America Declares First Quarter 2026 Stock Dividends. Bank of America Corporation today announced the Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend on Bank of America common stock of $0.28 per share, payable on March 27, 2026 to shareholders of record as of March 6, 2026.
